title: Common providers: Türkiye
coverage: Partial. Covers the national carrier, the three mobile network operators, the main fibre, cable and alternative broadband names and the research network; business ISPs and regional operators are thin.
missing: Regional ISPs and smaller alternative operators
Websites for TurkNet and Millenicom (they did not answer an automated request on the read date)
The regulator's list of authorised operators is an application that needs a browser: it could not be read
Names were checked in Latin script against English-language pages only

sources.name: BTK (Bilgi Teknolojileri ve İletişim Kurumu): authorisations
sources.terms: No reuse licence was read on the read date, so nothing is copied.
sources.result: The address answered on the read date but shows its list only in a browser. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Turkey and 3 more pages
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names and former names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 6 of 11 entries were found by a name on the 4 pages read.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 9 of 11 websites and 0 support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider or a company the entry names.
sources.result: 15 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: RIPE NCC list of AS names
sources.terms: No licence statement was read: used only to find candidate AS numbers, each then confirmed as above; nothing is copied.
sources.result: Read to find which AS numbers are registered under each provider's company names.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

providers.name: Türk Telekom
